name: Storage Kernel Adapter Wiring
description: Wire real storage adapters behind the storage kernel ports while preserving in-memory tests as reference. Implementation order: PGlite/PostgreSQL first (durable truth), then Valkey (coordination visibility), then DuckDB (projection). Do not expand reconciliation logic — attach adapters that obey the same contract as the mock.
purpose: Attach PGlite/PostgreSQL, Valkey, and DuckDB adapters to DurableAuthorityPort, CoordinationPort, and ProjectionPort respectively. Prove real adapters obey the same contract as the mock implementation.
